   Sports Kayshon Boutte Week 10 Preview vs. the Browns
 Nov 14, 2026 Photo : Ryan Sirius Sun / Getty Images Sport / Getty Images 
 Kayshon Boutte has a tough matchup when his Houston Texans face the Cleveland Browns in Week 10 (Sunday, 1 p.m. ET). The Browns give up 201 passing yards per game, sixth-best in the NFL.
 Boutte has 19 catches for 319 yards and two TDs this campaign. He has been targeted 28 times.
 Listen to the game on SportsRadio 610 
 Boutte vs. the Browns
 Boutte vs the Browns (since 2021): 1 GP / 75 REC YPG / 1 REC TD
 Cleveland has allowed 100 or more receiving yards to two opposing receivers in the 2026 season.
 12 players have hauled in a TD pass against the Browns this year.
 No player has recorded more than one TD reception against Cleveland on the season.
 The Browns allow 201 passing yards per game, the NFL's sixth-ranked pass defense this season.
 The Browns' defense ranks 10th in the league with 12 passing TDs allowed so far this year.
 Catch NFL action all year long on Fubo. 
 Boutte Receiving Insights
 In the receiving game, Boutte has gone over on his receiving yards prop bet in 75.0% of his games (six of eight).
 Boutte has 9.8% of his team's target share (28 targets on 285 passing attempts).
 He has been targeted 28 times, averaging 11.4 yards per target (sixth in NFL).
 In one of eight games this season, Boutte has registered a touchdown catch, with more than one TD in that contest.
 He has 9.1% of his team's 22 offensive touchdowns this season (two).
 Boutte has been targeted four times in the red zone (11.4% of his team's 35 red zone pass attempts).
